framing_issues.text: Sheriff Patrick Labat called the arrangement unfair "to county agencies and taxpayers," FOX 5 reported.
framing_issues.issue: Quote marks wrap FOX 5's paraphrase, so the reporter's words read as the sheriff's own. His actual quote in P-078 mentions neither agencies nor taxpayers.

framing_issues.text: The justice officials object to presenting their needs "to a two-commissioner panel rather than the full board," FOX 5 reported.
framing_issues.issue: Same pattern: FOX 5's narration (P-076) is in quote marks as if the officials said it.

framing_issues.text: The officials said funding decisions "could affect court delays, jail conditions and public safety," Atlanta News First reported.
framing_issues.issue: Same pattern: Atlanta News First's narration (P-069) is in quote marks as the officials' words.

framing_issues.text: 2. Only the full Board can adopt or change the budget.
framing_issues.issue: Listed under 'What's different this year', but the Board's power did not change (P-014: final authority 'remains exclusively' with the full Board). Readers may think this is new.

framing_issues.text: So the adopted General Fund ended within about 0.4% of the proposal, which the county manager had drafted alone.
framing_issues.issue: The net 0.4% hides $37.2 million in gross Board changes to the manager's draft, including +$18.2 million for the jail consent decree (P-054). Offered as a challenge to the supporters' card, it implies the old process needed little Board change, which the gross figures don't show. The point of the challenge is also left unstated.

framing_issues.text: The limit covers only requests for extra money above the base budget. ... Requests above 5% can still be seen: the public defender's full request is in its posted slides.
framing_issues.issue: The challenge to the critics' card is firmer than its evidence. 'Only' goes beyond P-029/P-077, the base-budget definition is from FY2026, and 'can still be seen' generalizes from one office's slides.

framing_issues.text: On the revenue side, it dropped a proposed $32,170,000 line of "Additional Property Taxes" and raised the regular property tax line by $18,535,960.
framing_issues.issue: Without the net, 'raised the regular property tax line' can read as a tax increase. Total property-tax revenue actually ended $13.6 million below the proposal ($847,666,192 proposed vs $834,032,152 adopted, P-054).

framing_issues.text: A proposal to change how drafts are built (Option C) was filed on Nov 4.
framing_issues.issue: 'Filed' usually means submitted; here it means set aside. Layer 3 readers could think Option C is newly pending. The same applies to the line 109 heading and line 127.

framing_issues.text: On Nov 8, the county had posted neither the 2027 proposal nor a date for the budget hearing.
framing_issues.issue: Stronger than what was checked: only two web pages (P-045, P-042), and line 27 says the other notice channels were not checked.

framing_issues.text: FOX 5 reported that Ellis addressed the officials' concerns.
framing_issues.issue: 'Addressed' (FOX 5's verb) can suggest the concerns were resolved. 'Responded to', used for the same exchange in the ANF sentence, is more neutral.

framing_issues.text: That is about 3.3 times 5% of the office's 2026 budget.
framing_issues.issue: Uses the 2026 adopted amount as the base, but the limit is set against the 'base budget' (P-029), which may differ. State the stand-in.

framing_issues.text: Each speaker gets up to two minutes, and people from Fulton County and its businesses and groups go first.
framing_issues.issue: Leaves out practical rules in P-036: county staff verify each speaker's residency, and public comment is capped at 60 minutes, with the rest moved to the end of the meeting.
